think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed values. 2) Check whether it is a numeric knob with a natural ordering. 3) If numeric, check documentation for sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that change semantics (disable/auto/meaningfully different mode) rather than just scaling. 4) If it’s boolean/enum, it does not fit the ‘special numerical knob’ definition. 5) Conclude special_knob=true only if such sentinel numeric values exist; otherwise false, and record any special_value only when applicable.
